- All four fingers (index, middle, ring, little) are fully extended straight upward, held together or with minimal natural spacing
- The thumb is held alongside the index finger, not spread away
- Palm faces forward toward the audience
- No bends in any finger joints - completely flat hand

Starting from the current pose (fingers splayed, thumb out), I need to:
1. Bring fingers together (reduce abduction)
2. Extend all fingers fully (set all joint angles to 0)
3. Position thumb alongside index finger
4. Adjust hand orientation to face palm forward
